text_blocks.snippet: The prognosis for type 2 diabetes varies, with life expectancy potentially shortened by several years depending on how well the condition is managed. While type 2 diabetes is a chronic, lifelong condition with no cure, individuals can significantly improve their prognosis and quality of life through lifestyle changes, medication, and blood sugar monitoring. Effective management can help prevent or delay serious complications like cardiovascular disease, kidney disease, nerve damage, and vision loss.
